card.name: Dose schedule endings: meals and frequency
card.fires_on: The last word of a dosing phrase, such as meals or food after "with", or twice and t.i.d. right after a mg amount. It appears mostly in dosing and administration instructions.

modes.label: Food with dose
modes.description: Meal or food word ending "once daily with ..." instructions.
modes.example: reduce the dose to 300 mg orally once daily with<< food>>.

modes.label: Frequency after mg
modes.description: Twice or t.i.d. directly after a milligram amount.
modes.example: begin with a dose that is at least 5 mg<< twice>> daily below the largest dose in the week
